SceneCapturePossibility.description:
ONE example way a scene's `what_to_capture` COULD be realized — an illustration,
NEVER a required shot. Mirrors v1 CapturePossibility so Coverage mapping is identical.
`id` is server-minted stable identity (drives represented/Shoot/Reshoot affordances).

id.description: server/domain-minted stable id; model ordinal is coerced, never canonical
id.title: Id

label.description: short example expression, e.g. 'the first glimpse of the skyline'
label.title: Label

semantic_purpose.description: what this example expresses (optional; used by Director handoff)
semantic_purpose.title: Semantic Purpose

SceneCapturePossibility.title: SceneCapturePossibility

StoryGuideScene.description:
One concrete, event-specific shooting scene (the AI shooting-script unit). Written
in a friendly-director voice for a non-filmmaker. `id` is server-minted STABLE
Story-local identity (StoryCoverage/2 references it by id exactly like a v1 dimension).
`visual_reference_query` is a GENERIC composition/action description for an image
search — it carries NO user media, NO personal details, NO full event description, and
the model NEVER emits image ids/urls/attribution (those are attached server-side).

capture_possibilities.description: a FEW (prefer 1-3) illustrative expressions; examples, not requirements
capture_possibilities.title: Capture Possibilities

how_to_shoot.description: practical, accessible advice: framing, movement, perspective, shot variety or duration — no jargon
how_to_shoot.title: How To Shoot

id.description: server/domain-minted STABLE id; model ordinal is coerced, never canonical
id.title: Id

title.description: short, memorable, EVENT-SPECIFIC scene title (never a generic template)
title.title: Title

visual_reference_query.description: GENERIC composition/action search phrase for a reference image (e.g. 'wide shot city skyline at dusk'). No personal details, no user media, no image ids/urls/attribution.
visual_reference_query.title: Visual Reference Query

what_to_capture.description: a concrete filming opportunity, in plain language
what_to_capture.title: What To Capture

why_it_matters.description: short explanation of the scene's storytelling value
why_it_matters.title: Why It Matters

StoryGuideScene.title: StoryGuideScene

description:
FROZEN-ON-SHIP story_guide/2 (additive to story_guide/1). Generated ONCE from
CreativeIntent at Story creation (async, non-blocking); stable while StoryCoverage
recomputes. A friendly, event-specific shooting script of a SMALL number of scenes
shown most-relevant-first. The `visual_reference_query` fields are text-only search
descriptions; provider image metadata is attached SEPARATELY and never by the model.

framing_summary.description: ONE short human-readable statement of what this Story is trying to capture (app's calm voice)
framing_summary.title: Framing Summary

scenes.description: SMALL, scope-sensitive set of event-specific shooting scenes
scenes.title: Scenes

source_creative_intent_version.description: provenance: which resolved CreativeIntent this Guide was built from
source_creative_intent_version.title: Source Creative Intent Version

title: StoryGuideV2
